name: qwen36_27b_grpo_selfeval_asi2
description: GRPO training for Qwen3.6-27B on ASI2 with self-evaluation using the model itself. Tasks target quantum coding: correctness, runnability, efficiency. Adapters auto-saved to NAS every 2 hours.

judge_criteria: correctness (does the algorithm produce the right quantum state / result)
runnability (does the code execute without errors)
efficiency (is the circuit depth / gate count / resource usage reasonable)
code_quality (is it well-structured, readable, uses proper quantum patterns)

adaptive_difficulty.description: Questions should be at the boundary of current model/adapter capabilities. The curriculum EMA decay of 0.9 ensures task weights adjust based on reward signal - tasks with low mean reward get more sampling weight (difficult tasks), while tasks with saturated high reward get less (too easy). Temperature escalation via adaptive_temp handles cases where even easy tasks get stuck.

preflight_gates: repo code synced to remote root
torch, torch_npu, transformers, peft, and accelerate import or the run is blocked
